items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: the judge had the same type of head like Sadat, same type of head

ctx.x: when they want you to come to them, they wave their hand away from you. I thought he was saying go away and he said you come here. So he made me know he meant for me to come. He grabbed me and so I said -- so Chitelson and I were down to the station house, so from 5:00 to 12:00 that man was writing. I don't know what had he done for all that writing to be going on but now 12:00, after they had said their prayers and everything, they took us in a big tent. We were sitting down in there, and the girls were on the…

So the judge come in, and the judge had the same type of head like Sadat, same type of head, he come in and he tried a few cases, and ______ told them to take him out of there, and then he come to Chitelson. Says ______ Chitelson, no comprehend. (unintelligible)
